intro.h2: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling in Houston, TX, done start to finish
paragraphs: CV Home Renovation LLC handles kitchen and bathroom remodeling in Houston, TX, along with the rest of the house: drywall, texture, painting, flooring, additions and outdoor builds. Kitchen remodels come up more than anything else in our Google reviews, where we hold a 5.0 rating across 21 reviews.

One family says we put in new flooring and upgraded their cabinets, finished on time, and the quality went past what they expected. Another homeowner credits Carlos with walking them through the design and installation of their new bathroom. And one customer is still smiling about a house that went from popcorn ceilings to clean knockdown texture.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: From new flooring to upgraded cabinets, we rework kitchens so they look and work better. Granite, quartz and full remodels are what we lead with, so countertops are part of the conversation too. Tell us what bothers you about your kitchen today and we will plan around it.

image.alt: Illustration of a kitchen with white cabinets, granite counters and wood-look plank flooring

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: A bathroom remodel has a lot of small decisions, and our customers notice the help. One homeowner says Carlos was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable about both design and installation. We take on tile, vanities, fixtures and flooring, whether it is a guest bath or the main one.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a remodeled bathroom in a Texas suburban home: a walk-in shower with large white marble-look porcelain wall tile, a recessed niche, a black hexagon mosaic floor and a frameless glass panel, a navy vanity with a white quartz top and brushed gold faucet, soft natural light from a frosted window, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Illustration of a bathroom with a marble-look tile shower, black hexagon floor and navy vanity

items.name: Drywall, texture and painting
items.blurb: Popcorn ceilings, cracked drywall and tired paint are everyday work for us. One customer had the whole house retextured from popcorn to knockdown. We mask floors, windows and the fireplace before scaffolding goes up, then finish the walls and ceilings in the colors you pick.

image.alt: Living room with a vaulted ceiling under repaint, floors covered in paper and windows masked in plastic, with rolling scaffolding in place

items.name: Outdoor kitchens and concrete
items.blurb: Our outdoor work includes concrete slabs, patios and full outdoor kitchens. One build pairs a brick pizza oven with a cream stone counter, a granite top and a built-in sink on a fresh slab. Decks, fencing, brick and masonry are on our list as well.

image.alt: Outdoor kitchen with a cream stone counter, granite top and built-in sink beside a brick pizza oven on a new concrete slab

items.name: Additions and exterior work
items.blurb: When a house needs more room or a new skin, we frame additions and handle roofing, siding and general home repairs. These jobs pair well with the interior work above, so one crew can carry a project from the framing stage through paint.

about.text: CV Home Renovation LLC is a Houston construction company built around one simple idea: bring the homeowner's vision to life with careful craftsmanship. Carlos is the name customers mention, often for how much he knows about design and installation. Our crew takes on kitchens and bathrooms, drywall and texture, painting, flooring, framing, roofing, siding, fencing, decks, brick, concrete and the general repairs that pile up in any home. We are open Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 7 PM, and every estimate is free.

steps.title: Reach out
steps.text: Call or text (832) 609-3506, Monday to Saturday between 9 AM and 7 PM, and tell us about the room or project.

steps.title: Free estimate
steps.text: We look at the space, listen to what you want and put together a free estimate before any work begins.

steps.title: Design and selections

steps.title: Build with care

steps.title: Final look together

service_area.h2: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling across Houston, TX
service_area.text: CV Home Renovation LLC works with homeowners in Houston, TX. Most of our projects are inside the house, from kitchens and baths to ceilings and floors, but we also pour slabs and build outdoor kitchens. If you live near Houston and are not sure we cover your neighborhood, call or text (832) 609-3506 with your address and a quick description of the job, and we will tell you.

items.a: Yes. Every estimate is free, whether you need one room painted or a full kitchen remodel. Call or text (832) 609-3506 to set a time, and we will look at the space, talk through what you want and give you a price before any work starts.

items.q: Can you remove a popcorn ceiling?
items.a: Yes. One customer had popcorn texture replaced with knockdown throughout the house and says it came out great. We protect floors, windows and fixtures first, take down the old texture, apply the new finish and paint, so the room is ready to live in again.

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel with you include?
items.a: It depends on your kitchen. Recent jobs have included new flooring and upgraded cabinets, and countertops are part of what we do as well. We start from what you want to change, then plan the work and the order it happens in so the kitchen is out of use for as short a time as possible.

items.q: Do you do work outside the house too?
items.a: Yes. Besides kitchens and baths we pour concrete, build patios, decks and fences, do brick and masonry, and handle roofing, siding and additions. One of our outdoor kitchens has a brick pizza oven, a stone counter, a granite top and a built-in sink on a new slab.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 7 PM and closed on Sunday. The fastest way to reach us is to call or text (832) 609-3506 with a short description of the project and a few photos of the space if you have them.

final_cta.text: Call or text Carlos and the crew for a free estimate on your kitchen, bathroom or next project.
